correctness.rationale: Proved classification of all 11n connected four-sets; 2connected five-set obstruction via no C5 and no K2,3; six explicit ordered free-triangle collapses leave a simply connected two-complex with rank binomial(2n-1,3)-11n. Integral Alexander duality, the full lower skeleton and Hurewicz–Whitehead prove the primal wedge for every n>=5. The complete standalone program enumerates n=5..12, excludes 5-faces through n=10, checks collapse cofaces at every step, and verifies the primal boundary rank mod 2,3,5,101 for n=5,6,7. Finite checks are not treated as an unbounded proof.
